claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Wärtsilä 或其資料中心客戶的一手寫出這類案場改用燃氣渦輪、燃料電池或電網取代引擎機組，或 Wärtsilä 寫出資料中心訂單取消。核查頻率：每季（Wärtsilä 季報與訂單新聞稿）。觸發後 48 小時：降 e1 confidence，重讀 tech:onsite_gas_power 的元件組成。
claims.statement: Engine supplier's press release (Wärtsilä, 2026-06-29): Wärtsilä will supply natural gas engines (34SG) for a power plant serving large-scale data center development in the U.S.; AI-driven data center projects require on-site power capacity. Gas engine generator sets are a component of onsite natural gas power for data centers. The release does not use the word 'reciprocating'; that the 34SG is a reciprocating spark-gas engine is a modeling judgment (Bloom's 10-K separately describes gas reciprocating engines as onsite firm resources).

claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Liberty 的 10-Q／8-K 寫出 Wärtsilä 合約終止或大幅縮減，或 Wärtsilä 的訂單新聞稿撤回。核查頻率：每季（Liberty 10-Q）。觸發後 48 小時：降 e2 confidence。
claims.statement: Liberty Energy placed a EUR 292 million order for Wärtsilä 34SG natural gas engines for a data center power plant, with delivery to site from 2029 through 2030 (supplier's statement naming the buyer; Liberty's own 10-Q separately files the Wärtsilä purchase contract).

source_doc.title: Wärtsilä 新聞稿（2026-06-29）：Wärtsilä secures new order to power next wave of AI-driven data center growth in the U.S.——Liberty Energy 下 2.92 億歐元燃氣引擎訂單（34SG），2029–2030 交到現場

sources.quote: Technology group Wärtsilä will supply engines for a power plant to ensure reliable supply of energy for large-scale data center development in the U.S.
The €292 million order, expected to be booked by Wärtsilä in Q3 2026, was placed by Denver-based Liberty Energy, a leading U.S. energy services company.
AI-driven data center projects require reliable, flexible on-site power capacity that can be rapidly deployed to offer predictable performance and availability.
Wärtsilä 34SG engines run on natural gas, a platform proven to perform in demanding, high-temperature environments.
The equipment delivery to site is scheduled to begin in 2029 and continue through 2030.
